items.title: Zero SR/S Wire Harness
items.text:
Wiring harness documentation traced from a Zero Motorcycles SR/S (Gen3 FST platform).

Each harness page shows the wiring diagram and its bill of materials. Diagrams are generated from the YAML sources in harness/ with WireViz.
